desc: The HMI layer shall display the Language customer setting and allow the customer to modify the setting through the LTM or ETM screen. The HMI layer shall update and manage the Language setting based on the customer selection in the display. The LTM or ETM shall display the available language options according to the configured market/language settings. Any invalid customer selection shall be considered invalid by the HMI.

family: Blind Spot Alert_Passive Entry_Phone Repetition_Park Sense_features
title: Language
desc: The HMI layer shall send a request to VehicleConfigManager to retrieve the Country_Code and Additional Languages PROXI configurations. VehicleConfigManager shall communicate with VehicleConfigService, and VehicleConfigService shall check the requested Country_Code and Additional Languages values from SystemProperties / HW configuration. The response shall be returned from SystemProperties to VehicleConfigService, then to VehicleConfigManager, and finally to the HMI layer. The HMI layer shall evaluate the received Country_Code and Additional Languages PROXI values and display the set of languages in the LTM or ETM screen as specified in the Market Configuration Table. The displayed language options shall be determined according to the configured Country_Code and Additional Languages PROXI parameters. Any invalid PROXI value shall be considered invalid by the HMI.

The HMI layer shall send a request to VehicleConfigManager to retrieve the Rain_Sensor  PROXI configuration.
VehicleConfigManager shall communicate with VehicleConfigService, and VehicleConfigService shall check the requested Rain_Sensor value from SystemProperties / HW configuration.
The response shall be returned from SystemProperties to VehicleConfigService, then to VehicleConfigManager, and finally to the HMI layer .The HMI layer shall evaluate the received $Rain_Sensor$  value.
If $Rain_Sensor$ = [Present], the HMI shall display the Rain Sensing Wipers customer setting to allow the customer to modify the setting.

CarPropertyService shall forward the request to the Vehicle HAL (VHAL) via IVehicle.setValues() with the corresponding VehiclePropValue.
The Vehicle HAL (VHAL) shall forward the request signal to the HW

title: Rain Sensing Wipers
desc:
The HW Supplier / ECU shall send the updated Rain Sensing Wipers status via the IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.RainSensorLevel signal.
The Vehicle HAL (VHAL) shall receive the IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.RainSensorLevel value and propagate it via IVehicleCallback.onPropertyEvent().
CarPropertyService shall receive the property event and notify CarPropertyManager via ICarPropertyEventListener.onChangeEvent().
CarPropertyManager shall invoke the CarPropertyEventCallback.onChangeEvent() to notify the HMI layer.
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received $RainSensorLevel$ value and update the Rain Sensing Wipers setting display accordingly.

title: Time and Date Settings
desc: The HMI layer shall display the Time & Date customer setting and allow the customer to modify the settings through the LTM or ETM screen. The HMI layer shall update and manage the Time & Date settings based on the customer selection in the display. The display behavior and interaction shall follow the Radio HMI Look & Feel (L&F) guidelines. Any invalid customer selection shall be considered invalid by the HMI.

title: Time and Date Settings
desc: The HMI layer shall update the internal Time and Date setting signals based on the customer's input and send the selected values to the Date & Time Service using the signals Hour1_Setting.Info, Hour2_Setting.Info, Minute1_Setting.Info, Minute2_Setting.Info, Day1_Setting.Info, Day2_Setting.Info, Month1_Setting.Info, Month2_Setting.Info, Year1_Setting.Info, Year2_Setting.Info, Year3_Setting.Info, and Year4_Setting.Info. The Date & Time Service shall process and update the corresponding signal values according to the customer-selected Time and Date settings. The time values for Hour1_Setting.Info, Hour2_Setting.Info, Minute1_Setting.Info, and Minute2_Setting.Info shall always be processed in 24-hour mode. Any invalid signal values shall be considered invalid by the HMI.

title: Time and Date Settings
desc:

VehicleConfigManager shall communicate with VehicleConfigService, and VehicleConfigService shall check the requested NAV_Presence value from SystemProperties / HW configuration.

The HMI layer shall evaluate the received NAV_Presence PROXI value to determine the availability of the GPS Automatic Time Adjustment feature.
If $NAV_Presence$ = [Absend], the LTM or ETM shall not display the GPS Automatic 
Time Adjustment customer setting do not  allow the customer the ability to modify the setting.

title: Suspension Flash Lights With Lower
desc:
The HMI layer shall send a request to VehicleConfigManager to retrieve the  CAN node 27 (ASM/ASCM) PROXI configuration status.
VehicleConfigManager shall communicate with VehicleConfigService to obtain the requested configuration values.
VehicleConfigService shall read and verify the NetCfg_ASCM and Market_Area configuration values from SystemProperties and/or HW configuration data. The configuration response shall be returned from SystemProperties to VehicleConfigService, from VehicleConfigService to VehicleConfigManager.

If CAN node 27 (ASM or ASCM) = [Absent] and Market_Area ≠ [NAFTA], the HMI shall suppress and not display the "Suspension Flash Lights With Lower" customer setting in the Vehicle Settings menu.

The configuration response shall be returned from SystemProperties to VehicleConfigService, from VehicleConfigService to VehicleConfigManager, and finally to the (HMI, LTM/ETM)layer.

If $CAN node 27 (ASM/ASCM)$ = [Present] and $Market_Area$ = [NAFTA], the HMI shall display the "Suspension Flash Lights With Lower" customer setting in the Vehicle Settings menu and allow the customer to modify the setting.

title: Suspension Flash Lights With Lower
desc:
When the customer chooses to disable the “Suspension Flash Lights With Lower” setting on the LTM or ETM, the HMI layer shall send the updated customer preference to CarPropertyManager via the Android Car API.
CarPropertyManager shall invoke setProperty() with propId = Susp_Flsh_Lght_Low_Req and value = [OFF].
CarPropertyService shall forward the request to Vehicle HAL (VHAL) via IVehicle.setValues().
The Vehicle HAL (VHAL) shall transmit the updated signal to the IPC/HW through the vehicle communication interface.

The HMI receives the value as OFF via signal,
 $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Susp_Flsh_Lght_Low_Req$.
Then the HMI/LTM/ETM shall update the  customer setting status to OFF in the Vehicle Settings menu.
The signal shall be transmitted to IPC within the defined system response time.

title: Suspension Flash Lights With Lower
desc:
The HW supplier shall provide the IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Susp_Flsh_Lght_Low signal to the Android Automotive software layer through the vehicle communication network and Vehicle HAL (VHAL) interface.

The HMI/LTM/ETM layer shall process the updated setting information.

When the LTM or ETM receives the ON or OFF value via signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Susp_Flsh_Lght_Low$, the LTM or ETM shall update the corresponding setting status on the display.

title: Suspension Default Ride Height
desc:
The HMI layer shall send a request to VehicleConfigManager to retrieve the Hybrid_Type and VC_SRT_PRSNT PROXI configuration status.
VehicleConfigManager shall communicate with VehicleConfigService to obtain the requested configuration values.
VehicleConfigService shall read and verify the Hybrid_Type and VC_SRT_PRSNT configuration values from SystemProperties and/or HW configuration data.
The configuration response shall be returned from SystemProperties to VehicleConfigService, from VehicleConfigService to VehicleConfigManager, and finally to the HMI/LTM/ETM layer.

The HW supplier shall provide the Hybrid_Type and VC_SRT_PRSNT PROXI configuration signals through the vehicle communication network in accordance with the CAN mapping defined in "Logical Identifiers and CAN Mapping v1_73" for Atl-High architecture.

If Hybrid_Type ≠ [BEV] and ≠ [REPB], and VC_SRT_PRSNT ≠ [Present], the corresponding feature section shall be enabled and available in the Vehicle Settings menu.

If Hybrid_Type = [BEV] or [REPB], or VC_SRT_PRSNT = [Present], the corresponding feature section shall be suppressed and not displayed in the Vehicle Settings menu.

title: SWITCH 1 Power Mode
desc:
When the customer chooses to set the SWITCH 1 Power Mode setting to Ignition on the LTM or ETM, the HMI layer shall send the updated customer preference to CarPropertyManager via the Android Car API.
CarPropertyManager shall invoke setProperty() with propId = AUX1_PWRMD_Req and value = [IGNITION].
CarPropertyService shall forward the request to Vehicle HAL (VHAL) via IVehicle.setValues().
The Vehicle HAL (VHAL) shall forward the signal to the HW through the vehicle communication interface.

HMI receives the value as IGNITION via signal,
$TELEMATIC_FD_1.AUX1_PWRMD_Req$
Then HMI shall display the SWITCH 1 Power Mode status as IGNITION.
The signal shall be sent to IPC within the defined system response time.
AUX Switch 1 is powered only when the vehicle ignition is ON (RUN/ACC state).
When the vehicle is turned OFF, the accessory connected to AUX 1 loses power automatically.

desc:

CarPropertyManager shall invoke setProperty() with propId = AUX1_PWRMD_Req and value = [BATTERY].
CarPropertyService shall forward the request to Vehicle HAL (VHAL) via IVehicle.setValues().
The Vehicle HAL (VHAL) shall forward the signal to the HW through the vehicle communication interface.

HMI receives the value as BATTERY via signal,
$TELEMATIC_FD_1.AUX1_PWRMD_Req$
Then HMI shall display the SWITCH 1 Power Mode status as BATTERY.
The signal shall be sent to IPC within the defined system response time.
The SWITCH 1 Power Mode = BATTERY means the accessory connected to AUX Switch 1 gets power directly from the vehicle battery, even when the vehicle ignition is OFF.

When the customer chooses to set the Engine Off Power Delay setting to 10 minutes on the LTM or ETM, the HMI layer shall send the updated customer preference to CarPropertyManager via the Android Car API.
CarPropertyManager shall invoke setProperty() with propId = Eng_Off_Pwr_Delay_Req and value = [Ten_Min] to CarPropertyService.
CarPropertyService shall forward the request to the Vehicle HAL (VHAL) via IVehicle.setValues() with the corresponding VehiclePropValue.
The Vehicle HAL (VHAL) shall forward the request signal to the HW.

HMI receives the value as [Ten_Min] via signal,
$TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Eng_Off_Pwr_Delay_Req$
Then HMI shall display the Engine Off Power Delay status as 10 Minutes.

After the vehicle OFF conditions are satisfied, the retained vehicle power functions shall remain ON for 10 minutes before turning OFF automatically.

title: Engine Off Power Delay
desc:
The HW supplier shall provide the IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Eng_Off_Pwr_Delay signal to the Android Automotive layer through the vehicle communication network and VHAL interface.
VHAL shall forward the updated Engine Off Power Delay signal value to CarPropertyService, which shall update CarPropertyManager through the Android Automotive framework.
CarPropertyManager shall notify the application layer, and the HMI/LTM/ETM layer shall process the updated setting information.

When the LTM or ETM receives the value via signal,
$IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP.Eng_Off_Pwr_Delay$,
the LTM or ETM shall update the Engine Off Power Delay setting status information on the display within the defined system response time.

CarPropertyService shall receive the IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.Trailer_Light_Check signal from VHAL and forward it to CarPropertyManager. CarPropertyManager shall expose the value to HMI via API interface. The HMI layer shall evaluate the received IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.Trailer_Light_Check signal and update/display the Automatic Trailer Light Check setting information accordingly within <TDisplay>. Any invalid value shall be considered invalid by HMI.

title: Blind Spot with Trailer Detection
desc: The HMI layer shall send a request to VehicleConfigManager to retrieve the Blindspot_Trailer_Detection PROXI configuration. VehicleConfigManager shall communicate with VehicleConfigService, and VehicleConfigService shall check the requested Blindspot_Trailer_Detection value from SystemProperties / HW configuration. The response shall be returned from SystemProperties to VehicleConfigService, then to VehicleConfigManager, and finally to the HMI layer. The HMI layer shall evaluate the received Blindspot_Trailer_Detection PROXI value to determine the availability of the Blind Spot with Trailer Detection feature. If Blindspot_Trailer_Detection = [Absent], the LTM or ETM shall not display the Blind Spot with Trailer Detection customer setting.

desc: The HMI layer shall retrieve the SpeedUnit signal through CarPropertyManager.
